title: Steering Bayesian Inference and Decisions through Data Poisoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.19557v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adversarial machine learning has revealed that statistical models can be manipulated through poisoned data, and Bayesian inference is no exception. Earlier work has shown that subtle poisoning attacks can drive the posterior toward a distribution of the attacker's choosing. Such posterior attraction attacks require a fully specified target posterior; however, attackers typically care about only a few posterior quantities or, more consequentially, about a downstream decision. Herein, we study how an attacker can alter Bayesian inference and decisions by deleting or replicating a few observations, chosen to minimize the maximum mean discrepancy between the resulting posterior and a target distribution. A suitable kernel lets the attacker steer selected posterior moments without specifying the rest of the target. translated_title: 通过数据投毒引导贝叶斯推断与决策
translated_abstract: 对抗性机器学习已经揭示，统计模型可以通过被投毒的数据进行操纵，贝叶斯推断也不例外。先前的研究表明，微妙的投毒攻击可以将后验分布推向攻击者选定的分布。这种后验吸引攻击需要一个完全指定的目标后验分布；然而，攻击者通常只关心少数几个后验量，或者更关键的是，只关心下游决策。在本文中，我们研究攻击者如何通过删除或复制少量观测数据来改变贝叶斯推断和决策，这些观测数据的选择旨在最小化所得后验分布与目标分布之间的最大均值差异（MMD）。合适的核函数使攻击者能够操纵选定的后验矩，而无需指定目标的其余部分。由于贝叶斯行动仅通过期望效用依赖于后验分布，而期望效用本身就是后验矩，因此同样的方法……
tldr: 该论文提出一种数据投毒攻击方法：攻击者只需通过删除或复制少量精心选择的观测数据，即可操纵贝叶斯后验分布中的特定矩或下游决策，而无需完全指定目标后验分布。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data poisoning attack in which an attacker can steer selected posterior moments or downstream Bayesian decisions by deleting or replicating a few carefully chosen observations, without needing to fully specify a target posterior distribution.
